A QUICK FIELD GUIDE

From link to offline.

  1. 01
    Add a link to your queue.

    Your private BUFFER app connects to its video server automatically. A self-hosted copy can be connected in Settings.

  2. 02
    Keep BUFFER open.

    The server prepares the video; then the whole video is cached on your device. Interrupted caching can resume.

  3. 03
    Wait for “Ready offline.”

    Try playback in airplane mode. Play, pause, seek, and resume without a connection.

Made for your iPad.

Install from Safari using Share → Add to Home Screen. Cache videos inside that installed app. Safari tabs and Home Screen apps may use separate storage.

Use videos you own or have permission to save. YouTube extraction is unofficial, and some videos may be unavailable. Private, DRM-protected, paid, and age-gated videos are not supported.
